consumption.title: Consumption leaderboard
consumption.description: Compare token usage and costs by user, API key, or channel.
consumption.usageDescription: View request counts, token usage, and costs by user or API key in the current project.
consumption.projectLoadError: Project options could not be loaded. All-project statistics remain available.
consumption.cacheRequestsHelp: Requests that reported cache reads or writes.
consumption.cacheHitRateHelp: Cache read tokens divided by total input tokens of requests with cache reads or writes. Requests without cache activity are excluded.
consumption.cacheCoefficientHelp: Actual cache reads divided by theoretical cacheable tokens, adjusted for observable samples and sample count. A display-only score from 0 to 1, delayed by about 15–20 minutes.
consumption.successRateHelp: Successful requests divided by countable outcomes. Follows CCH exclusions for client aborts after response data, 404s, quota and rate limits.
consumption.firstTokenHelp: Average time from request start to the first meaningful output. Historical records without timing are excluded.
consumption.speedHelp: Average of each request's output tokens divided by time after its first response body byte. Missing timings, zero output, and intervals below 100ms are excluded.
consumption.empty: No data in the selected time range
consumption.cacheNote: Only requests with cache reads or writes are included. Cache coefficients lag by about 15–20 minutes.
consumption.costNote: Requests use their final attribution and recorded costs. Unavailable metrics appear as “—”.
